rule_results.title: Encryption of Data at Rest & End-to-End Encryption (E2EE)
rule_results.remediation: Migrate plaintext SharedPreferences and SQLiteDatabase to androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences and net.sqlcipher.database.SQLiteDatabase.
rule_results.details: Cryptographic at-rest storage mechanisms verified (EncryptedSharedPreferences / SQLCipher).

findings.description: Verified presence of EncryptedSharedPreferences or SQLCipher for data protection at rest.

rule_results.title: Prohibition of Logging Sensitive Authentication Data (SAD) & CHD
rule_results.remediation: Strip all log calls in release builds (using ProGuard/R8) and ensure sensitive parameters are sanitized before entering logging sinks.
rule_results.details: Logging calls present in APK; no obvious plaintext credential log formats found.

findings.description: General android.util.Log calls detected; ensure R8/ProGuard strips them in production.

rule_results.title: Transport Security, Cleartext Prohibition & Certificate Pinning
rule_results.remediation: Set cleartextTrafficPermitted='false' in network_security_config.xml and configure OkHttp CertificatePinner or network security config pin-set.
rule_results.details: Transport layer security compliant with Clause 4.1.5.19.

findings.description: Verified TLS enforcement and Certificate Pinning implementation.

rule_results.title: Cryptographic Algorithm Strength & Modern Cipher Suites
rule_results.remediation: Ensure modern SHA-256 is used for all security routines; purge legacy MD5/SHA-1 from dependencies.
rule_results.details: Advisory under Clause 4.1.5.19.c: Modern crypto verified; legacy hashes detected in dependencies.

findings.description: Legacy hashing primitive in auxiliary/third-party routines: Deprecated Hash: SHA-1
Legacy hashing primitive in auxiliary/third-party routines: Deprecated Hash: MD5
Legacy hashing primitive in auxiliary/third-party routines: Deprecated Hash: SHA1

rule_results.title: Secure Hardware Cryptographic Key Storage
rule_results.remediation: Generate and store master keys in AndroidKeyStore using KeyGenParameterSpec with PURPOSE_ENCRYPT | PURPOSE_DECRYPT.
rule_results.details: No AndroidKeyStore usage found in client binary.

findings.description: AndroidKeyStore not explicitly detected; verify if keys are stored in backend HSM.

rule_results.title: Transaction Signing, Non-Repudiation & Anti-Replay Protection
rule_results.remediation: Implement java.security.Signature with SHA256withRSA/ECDSA or javax.crypto.Mac with HmacSHA256 on all transaction payloads.
rule_results.details: Violation of Clause 4.1.3.10: Client application lacks transaction signing mechanisms.

findings.description: No digital signature or HMAC transaction signing primitives detected in client application.

rule_results.title: Cryptographically Secure Pseudo-Random Number Generation (PRNG)
rule_results.remediation: Replace all instances of java.util.Random or Math.random() in security-sensitive methods with java.security.SecureRandom.
rule_results.details: Complies with Clause 4.1.5.18: Secure pseudo-random number generator utilized.

findings.description: Verified java.security.SecureRandom usage for cryptographically secure randomness.

rule_results.title: Principle of Least Privilege & Permission Baseline Adherence
rule_results.remediation: Remove unnecessary permissions from AndroidManifest.xml and use Android SMS Retriever API instead of raw SMS read/send permissions.
rule_results.details: Violation of Clause 4.1.2.5 & 4.1.8.4: 2 invasive malware/spyware permissions requested (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, WRITE_CONTACTS).

findings.description: Severe/Invasive permission violating least privilege: android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
Severe/Invasive permission violating least privilege: android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS

rule_results.title: Hardened Baseline Manifest & Component Configuration
rule_results.remediation: Set android:allowBackup='false', android:debuggable='false', and ensure all exported activities/receivers declare android:permission.
rule_results.details: Manifest configuration conforms to Bangladesh Bank hardening standards.

findings.description: Manifest securely hardened: allowBackup=false, debuggable=false, components protected.

rule_results.title: Source Code Protection, Obfuscation & Anti-Tampering
rule_results.remediation: Enable ProGuard / R8 minification and DexGuard anti-tamper protections in build.gradle.
rule_results.details: Application source code obfuscation complies with Clause 4.1.4.4.

findings.description: Verified code minification/obfuscation (obfuscated class ratio: 77.6%).

rule_results.title: Embedded Credentials, Hardcoded API Secrets & Private Keys
rule_results.remediation: Move secrets to secure backend proxies or use dynamic token exchange with AndroidKeyStore protection.

rule_results.title: Screen Capture, Screenshot & Tapjacking Overlay Protection
rule_results.remediation: Apply getWindow().setFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE, WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE) on sensitive payment activities.
rule_results.details: Violation of Clause 4.1.8.6: Missing protection against screen capture and tapjacking overlays.

findings.description: No FLAG_SECURE or filterTouchesWhenObscured configurations identified in bytecode/manifest.

rule_results.title: Biometric Authentication Cryptographic Object Binding
rule_results.remediation: Migrate to androidx.biometric.BiometricPrompt and authenticate via BiometricPrompt.CryptoObject backed by AndroidKeyStore.
